basement_matrix_solver.agent_description: A specialized reasoning agent to systematically manage gate-switch state dependencies and solve complex switch mazes.
basement_matrix_solver.agent_system_prompt: You are a specialized maze and state machine solver. Given a set of switches, their locations, their gate-toggling behaviors, the current state of the global gates, and a target destination, your job is to calculate the precise sequence of switches to toggle in order to open the necessary gates and reach the target coordinates. Provide a step-by-step reasoning plan and the final sequence of switch interactions.
basement_matrix_solver.agent_input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"current_state":{"type":"string","description":"The current state of switches/gates"},"target_coordinates":{"type":"string","description":"The coordinates we want to reach"},"switch_locations":{"type":"string","description":"The known switch locations on the map"}},"required":["current_state","target_coordinates","switch_locations"]}
basement_matrix_solver.agent_output_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"switch_toggle_sequence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"The sequence of switch interactions to perform"},"reasoning":{"type":"string","description":"Detailed explanation of why this sequence is correct"}},"required":["switch_toggle_sequence","reasoning"]}
